ai.title: CLI exit handler now cleans up TUI renderer before process.exit
ai.summary: Added `cleanupRenderer` utility to explicitly destroy the TUI renderer before calling `process.exit(0)` in the CLI exit handler. This prevents garbled terminal output by ensuring mouse tracking, focus reporting, and raw mode are reset. The renderer is registered via `registerRendererForCleanup` in `index.tsx` and cleaned up in `use-exit-handler.ts`.

eli5.text: When you close the program, your terminal screen no longer gets left in a messy, unreadable state. Previously, the program shut down without first telling the fancy text interface to clean up after itself, which could garble your terminal output. Now, the program properly resets your terminal's special modes (like mouse tracking and full-screen display) before it exits, so your command line stays clean and usable.
